meta.name: aed:breadcrumbs:label
meta.description: Per-page override for the current page's breadcrumb label. Defaults to the page title.

json.description: Site-wide breadcrumb behavior. Optional — sensible defaults apply if omitted.

labels.description: Map of path → label overrides, e.g. { '/work': 'Case studies' }.

data.description: Per-instance flags on the breadcrumb nav element.

data-aed-skip-schema.description: Suppress the BreadcrumbList JSON-LD that otherwise gets injected for SEO.
